name: aether-sdk
description: Aether SDK — Multi-platform behavioral analytics and Web3 data collection

scripts.build: VITE_AETHER_ENV=production VITE_KYBER_ENV=production VITE_DEMO_ENV=production VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://api.invalid VITE_AETHER_ENDPOINT=https://api.invalid VITE_WS_BASE_URL=wss://api.invalid VITE_GRAPHQL_URL=https://api.invalid/v1/analytics/graphql VITE_OIDC_AUTHORITY=https://identity.invalid VITE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID=workspace-build VITE_OIDC_REDIRECT_URI=https://app.invalid/callback VITE_DEMO_TENANT_ID=certification-demo VITE_DEMO_SEED_NAMESPACE=certification VITE_AETHER_URL=https://app.invalid VITE_KYBER_URL=https://operator.invalid npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --project packages/web/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend/shared --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend/aether --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend/kyber --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend/demo --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/react-native --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/mobile-core --if-present
scripts.deps:unused: npx --yes depcheck@^1.4 packages/web && npx --yes depcheck@^1.4 packages/react-native && npx --yes depcheck@^1.4 frontend/kyber
scripts.security:deps: npm audit --omit=dev || true; (command -v pip-audit >/dev/null && pip-audit || echo 'pip-audit not installed (optional)')
scripts.security:vuln: echo 'Run a container/image scanner (e.g. trivy) against built images; see docs/VULNERABILITY-MANAGEMENT.md'
scripts.security:sbom: npx --yes @cyclonedx/cyclonedx-npm@^1 --output-file sbom.json || echo 'SBOM tool unavailable; see docs/DEPENDENCY-AUDIT.md'
scripts.security:licenses: npx --yes license-checker@^25 --summary || echo 'license-checker unavailable; see docs/DEPENDENCY-AUDIT.md'
scripts.security:audit: npm run security:secrets && npm run security:deps
scripts.load:smoke: python tests/load/generate_synthetic.py --tenants 3 --events 100 >/dev/null && echo 'load smoke ok (synthetic generation)'
scripts.load:ingestion: if command -v locust >/dev/null 2>&1; then locust -f tests/load/locustfile.py --host ${AETHER_HOST:-http://localhost:8000}; else echo 'locust not installed; see docs/LOAD-TESTING.md'; fi
scripts.test:frontend: npm run test --workspace=frontend/aether && npm run test --workspace=frontend/kyber && npm run test:component --workspace=frontend/kyber && npm run test:integration --workspace=frontend/kyber && npm run test --workspace=frontend/demo
scripts.test:security: npm run security:secrets && python -m pytest tests/unit/test_p4_security_billing.py -q
